mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances despite FEDFUNDS <1.0% over 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in unemployment (UNRATE <4.0%) signals a robust labor market, fostering growth and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain negative despite UNRATE falling below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP (GDPC1) and demand (RSAFS) signals robust economic activity, enhancing corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and RSAFS both rise >5% in 3 months
failure_condition: Rank IC <0.05 over 3-year window despite both proxies rising.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals recession fears, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive when FEDFUNDS >2.5% in tightening regime.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 95 indicates increased supply capacity, stimulating demand and growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.

A sharp increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 10,000 suggests strong economic growth, boosting corporate profits and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and rise in employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, enhancing growth prospects and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns negative despite UNRATE down and PAYEMS up.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 95 signals peak demand, prompting market adjustments that drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
